# LucidMind

LucidMind is an executive advisory firm helping organizations build leadership, operating models, and AI capabilities needed for the Adaptive Future.

## Website
- https://lucidmind.co.in/

## Core Advisory Services
- Enterprise AI Transformation: Operating model redesign, capability architecture, and value realization.
- Global Capability Centres (GCC) Advisory: Evolution from delivery hubs to strategic value engines.
- Leadership & Executive Coaching: Guidance by Ravishankar Pingali for CEOs, CIOs, and GCC leaders.
